description: Discover the 7 best AI video tools for brand content in 2026. From HeyGen to KlingAI, create professional brand videos faster.
body:
Video is no longer optional for brands in 2026. Social media algorithms favor video content, landing pages with video convert better, and clients increasingly expect video deliverables alongside traditional brand assets. The problem? Professional video production is expensive and time-consuming.

That is where AI video tools come in. These platforms let brand designers and marketers create polished video content in minutes, not weeks. Here are the 7 best AI video tools for brand content creation.

1. HeyGen — Best for AI Spokesperson Videos

HeyGen is the leading platform for creating AI avatar videos. Upload a script, choose an avatar (or create one from your own footage), and HeyGen produces a professional talking-head video with natural speech and expressions.

Key features:

  • 100+ realistic AI avatars with natural movement
  • Custom avatar creation from a 2-minute video clip
  • 40+ languages with lip-sync translation
  • Brand kit integration (logos, colors, fonts)
  • Template library for marketing, training, and social

Pricing: Free plan (1 credit). Creator plan at $24/month.

Best for: Brand teams creating explainer videos, product demos, and multilingual marketing content.

2. KlingAI — Best for AI-Generated Brand Video

KlingAI produces stunning AI-generated video from text or images. It is one of the most advanced text-to-video and image-to-video tools available, capable of creating cinematic brand content from a single prompt.

Key features:

  • Text-to-video with cinematic quality
  • Image-to-video animation for static brand assets
  • Motion brush controls for specific element animation
  • Up to 1080p resolution output
  • Lip sync for character animation

Pricing: Free credits available. Pro plans from $8/month.

Best for: Brand designers who need to turn static brand assets into dynamic video content for social media.

3. Synthesia — Best for Corporate Brand Videos

Synthesia is the enterprise-grade AI video platform trusted by Fortune 500 companies. It specializes in professional training, internal comms, and marketing videos with AI presenters.

Key features:

  • 200+ diverse AI avatars built for corporate use
  • 130+ languages with native-quality speech
  • Screen recording integration for product demos
  • Brand guidelines enforcement (colors, logos, templates)
  • SOC 2 compliant for enterprise security

Pricing: Starter plan at $22/month. Enterprise pricing available.

Best for: Agencies creating consultancy and corporate brand video content at scale.

4. ElevenLabs — Best for AI Brand Voice

ElevenLabs is the gold standard for AI voice generation. While not a video tool per se, it is essential for any brand video workflow, producing voiceovers that are virtually indistinguishable from human recordings.

Key features:

  • Ultra-realistic text-to-speech in 30+ languages
  • Voice cloning from just a few minutes of audio
  • Consistent brand voice across all content
  • Voice library with hundreds of preset voices
  • API for automated voiceover workflows

Pricing: Free plan (10,000 characters/month). Starter at $5/month.

Best for: Creating a consistent brand voice for podcasts, videos, and audio content. Pairs perfectly with AI brand strategy tools.

5. Riverside — Best for Brand Podcast and Interview Video

Riverside is a professional remote recording studio that captures high-quality audio and video from any browser. It is the go-to tool for brand podcasts, thought leadership interviews, and webinar content.

Key features:

  • 4K video and 48kHz audio recording
  • Local recording (no quality loss from internet issues)
  • AI-powered editing with Magic Clips for social media
  • Automatic transcription and captions
  • Multi-track recording for post-production flexibility

Pricing: Free plan (2 hours recording). Standard at $15/month.

Best for: Brand builders creating podcast content and thought leadership video. Great for startup founders building personal brands.

6. PlayHT — Best for AI Voiceover on a Budget

PlayHT offers high-quality AI voiceovers at a fraction of the cost of ElevenLabs. It is an excellent choice for brands that need lots of voice content without breaking the budget.

Key features:

  • 900+ AI voices across 140+ languages
  • Voice cloning with emotional range
  • Real-time voice generation for apps
  • Podcast hosting built in
  • Commercial usage rights on all plans

Pricing: Free trial. Creator plan at $31.20/month.

Best for: Brands that need high-volume voiceover content across multiple AI-powered branding touchpoints.

7. InVideo AI — Best for Social Media Brand Videos

InVideo AI lets you create complete social media videos from a text prompt. Describe what you want, and it generates a full video with stock footage, music, voiceover, and transitions.

Key features:

  • Text-to-video with automatic stock footage selection
  • AI voiceover and background music
  • 50+ social media formats (Reels, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Brand presets for consistent styling
  • Multi-language video generation

Pricing: Free plan (10 min/week). Plus plan at $25/month.

Best for: Brand teams that need to produce high volumes of social media content quickly.

How to Build an AI Video Workflow

Here is a practical workflow combining these tools:

  1. Strategy: Define your brand voice using our brand strategy template
  2. Voiceover: Create a consistent brand voice with ElevenLabs
  3. Talking heads: Generate spokesperson videos with HeyGen
  4. Motion graphics: Turn brand assets into video with KlingAI
  5. Social clips: Produce daily social content with InVideo AI
  6. Podcasts: Record interviews with Riverside

Final Thoughts

AI video tools have made professional brand content accessible to every budget level. The key is starting with a clear brand strategy and then using these tools to execute it consistently across video formats.
